records.title: B-Agent main — cross-analysis, merge-queue, paper-trader, Kaggle and model-merge safety audit
records.note: Main dd907... retains scheduled cross-analysis writes to main; a manual merge queue with contents/pull-requests write, dry_run=false and max_prs=0; a nonzero paper-trading position with null product identity; a daily Kaggle workflow invoking a missing root-level script while the implementation auto-submits to up to five competitions; and duplicate Hugging Face merge workflows that expose a global token to --trust-remote-code. The model merge config path is absent on main. The free-image workflow also has a missing root-level script, contents:write and job-level HF_TOKEN. The path mismatches currently block those workflows before the risky scripts execute. No workflow was dispatched.

records.title: PR #1374 — separate-runner Hugging Face upload isolation and workflow-input validation
records.note: Exact head 5f70b26... separates untrusted --trust-remote-code merge from token-bearing upload onto a fresh runner, exports model output through a one-day artifact, sets upload-job permissions to empty, rejects symlinks, passes model_name via environment with strict allowlist and quoting, and scopes HF_TOKEN to the final upload step. Exact-head CI 41087890290 passed 347 tests plus 8 subtests, including five workflow-safety tests; fail-closed gate 41087890315 passed. PR remains open/draft/unmerged. No artifact transfer, real Hugging Face upload or workflow dispatch was executed. Main is three commits ahead of the merge base, with no observed changed-path overlap. Merge config is absent on main; action refs and transitive dependencies remain unpinned.
